```python
import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# 设置数据库文件路径
db_path = '⟨workdir⟩'

# 连接到SQLite数据库
conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)

# 执行INNER JOIN查询
query = """
SELECT *
FROM sales_records s 
INNER JOIN purchase_price p ON p."Item Code" = s."Item Code" AND p."Date" = s."Sales Date"
INNER JOIN product_information pi ON pi."Item Code" = s."Item Code"
INNER JOIN product_loss pl ON pl."Item Code" = s."Item Code"
"""

# 使用pandas读取查询结果以便更好地显示
joined_data = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)

# 关闭数据库连接
conn.close()

# 显示数据的基本信息和前几行
print(f"总行数: {len(joined_data)}")
print(f"列数: {len(joined_data.columns)}")
print("\n前5行数据:")
print(joined_data.head())

print("\n列名:")
for i, col in enumerate(joined_data.columns):
    print(f"{i+1}. {col}")
```
